claims.content: The Auctioneer is logged into the Auction Administration system.
The Auctioneer has navigated to the 'Create New Auctions' page.
There are inventory items available in the database to be selected for the auction.
The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Create New Auctions' page in the Auction Administration system.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer navigates to the 'Create New Auctions' page in the Auction Administration system.

claims.content: A new auction event is created and populated with the selected inventory items.
The 'Active Date' for each scheduled item is set to a future date as specified by the Auctioneer.
The 'Starts' and 'Ends' timestamps for each item are configured according to the duration and start time settings applied by the Auctioneer.
Manual reserves (if any) are applied to the selected items as defined in the 'Apply Manual Reserves to Selections' section.
The system updates the status of the selected inventory items to reflect they are now assigned to an active or scheduled auction.
